# ISchemaVersioned

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public interface ISchemaVersioned
```

A manifest that declares the schema it was written against. Every archive manifest carries one so a future format can be rejected explicitly instead of silently misparsing.
